    """Wrap the velocity net when the checkpoint was trained with FLARE.

n_experts and the conditioning width are read off expert_scale's shape, so
    the evaluator cannot disagree with the trainer about either. A checkpoint
    without that key is returned untouched, which is every arm but one.

key = "velocity_net.expert_scale"
    if key not in state_dict:
        return policy
    n_experts, cond_dim = state_dict[key].shape
    from scripts.pusht_sfp.flare_pusht import wrap_policy
    print("[eval] FLARE checkpoint: %d experts, cond_dim %d, t_split %s, "
          "confidence_gate %s" % (n_experts, cond_dim, args.flare_t_split,
                                  args.flare_confidence_gate), flush=True)
    return wrap_policy(policy, n_experts=int(n_experts),
                       t_split=float(args.flare_t_split),
                       cond_dim=int(cond_dim),
                       confidence_gate=bool(args.flare_confidence_gate))
